EstmtEnergyUseCriteria.name: EstmtEnergyUseCriteria
EstmtEnergyUseCriteria.description: Represents the criteria to generate estimated energy use records.

Condition.description: The conditions that determine how to generate the energy use records.

FillMethod.description: Specifies the method to generate the energy use records.

Frequency.description: Specifies the frequency to generate the energy use records.

FuelType.description: Specifies the type of fuel consumed by the asset.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

ObjectDeveloperName.description: Specifies the developer name of emissions environmental source object.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns this record.
